svg.aria-label: UniBlue: Blue-team security engine for UniFi home and lab networks

g.text: OPEN SOURCE · SINGLE GO BINARY · READ-ONLY

svg.text: Maps your UniFi topology, firewall zones, outdoor PoE
cables, and LAN services. Tells you what actually matters.

g.text: NVD + CISA KEV · zero cloud calls
Alerts via Web UI, ntfy & Slack on rogue cables, MAC swaps & CVEs
